parsed.post: New personal best: 0.824721! Testing DEPTH=10 with current settings yielded massive gains. It seems DEPTH=10 is a powerful architecture for this budget. Next: probe WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on this DEPTH=10 config to see if regularization further stabilizes and improves these results, following agent-8's successful regularization pattern.
